intro: Fine Crab Chunks are prime cuts of meat gathered from the coastal crustaceans roaming the beaches of Darkshore. Highly prized for their culinary versatility, they are sought after by local shore-dwellers and hungry fishermen looking to prepare an endless variety of seafood dishes.

p: The misty, jagged shores of Darkshore are thick with skittering crustaceans, specifically Reef Crawlers and Encrusted Tide Crawlers. While many travelers view these armored shore-prowlers as pests or aggressive hazards along the waterline, enterprising gourmands consider their meat among the finest bounty of the coast. Prized cuts harvested from these creatures yield rich, tender morsels that lend themselves to practically any cooking method imaginable, from boiling and broiling to deep frying and savory stews.
